period_note: SBAC BANK LIMITED (pre-2023 name). Balance sheet is the 30-September-2016 period-end snapshot (reported), compared against the prior 31-December-2015 audited year-end. Income-statement items are CUMULATIVE from 1 January 2016 (the statement's own 'From 01 January 2016 to 30 September 2016' column; no discrete-quarter column is printed in this filing). No subsidiary existed yet in 2016, so this is unambiguously Solo/Standalone. Equity uses the same six-component layout as 2016_Q2.json (paid-up capital, statutory reserve, general reserve [nil], other/revaluation reserve, 'Current year's profit' [[=profit_after_tax_cumulative]], retained earnings brought forward); components sum exactly to total_equity (the printed total_equity cell itself is partly obscured by a signature in the source scan but is independently reproduced by summing its own components, and separately by total_assets-total_liabilities: both give 5,304,096,814 exactly). No classified-loans/NPL or capital-adequacy disclosure is present in this simple 4-page filing (no notes section) -- recorded as a gap, consistent with FY2014/FY2015 and 2016_Q2.json. This filing extracted natively via pdftotext -layout but with the two-column layout interleaved/misaligned; all figures below were read directly off 200dpi page images for accuracy, with the native pdftotext extraction kept in the archived .txt only as a secondary reference. PBT-minus-tax reproduces PAT to within Tk.1 (966,087,382-334,727,598=966,087,382-334,727,598... =631,359,784 vs the printed 631,359,783), an immaterial one-Taka rounding artifact in the source document itself, not a transcription error here.
